title: Template:PrizePoolRowColor
wikitext:
<includeonly>{{#switch: {{{1}}}
    |1 = class="background-color-first-place"
    |2 =  class="background-color-second-place"
    |3-4
    |3 =  class="background-color-third-place"
    |4 = class="background-color-fourth-place"
    |dq = class="background-color-disqualified"
    |w =  class="background-color-win"
    |l =  class="background-color-lose"
}}</includeonly><noinclude>{{documentation}}[[Category:Prize pool templates]]</noinclude>
